name: Tennessee

flag.description: A red field with a blue disc edged in white in the centre, holding three white five-pointed stars; at the fly end is a narrow white stripe and a broader blue vertical stripe.
flag.symbolism: The three stars stand for East, Middle and West Tennessee, the state's three Grand Divisions, bound together by the unbroken circle.

hook: Tennessee is three white stars in a blue circle on red, one for each of its three Grand Divisions.
trivia: The flag was designed by LeRoy Reeves, an officer of the Third Tennessee Infantry.
Its designer said the blue bar at the fly stops the flag showing nothing but red when it hangs limp.
